# docker_buildx_history (Data Source)

Reads one build record of a buildx builder, like `docker buildx history inspect`: context, Dockerfile, target, platforms, status, timing, step counts and attestation attachments. Records come from BuildKit's build history API on the builder's running nodes; materials come from the record's provenance attestation, and `attachment` reads one attachment's body from the builder's content store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The newest build record of the daemon's builder. ref also accepts a
# builder/node/ref value from docker_buildx_bake's build_refs, or "^1" for
# the build before the newest.
data "docker_buildx_history" "last" {
  builder = "default"
  ref     = "^0"
}

output "last_build" {
  value = {
    name     = data.docker_buildx_history.last.name
    status   = data.docker_buildx_history.last.record.status
    cached   = "${data.docker_buildx_history.last.record.num_cached_steps}/${data.docker_buildx_history.last.record.num_total_steps}"
    revision = data.docker_buildx_history.last.vcs_revision
  }
}

# The provenance attestation of the newest build, and its materials.
data "docker_buildx_history" "provenance" {
  ref        = "^0"
  attachment = "provenance"
}

output "build_materials" {
  value = [for m in data.docker_buildx_history.provenance.record.materials : m.digests]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `attachment` (String) Attachment whose body to read into `attachment_body`, like `docker buildx history inspect attachment`: its digest (a unique prefix is enough), or a type: `provenance`, `sbom`, or a full predicate or media type (`--type`).
- `attachment_platform` (String) Platform of the attachment to read, for multi-platform builds (`--platform`), e.g. `linux/arm64`.
- `builder` (String) Builder whose records are read (`--builder`). Default `default`, the daemon's built-in BuildKit; other names are docker-container builders on the provider's daemon (see `docker_buildx_builder`).
- `ref` (String) Build record to read: its ref (a unique prefix is enough), a `builder/node/ref` value as `docker_image` and `docker_buildx_bake` report it, or `^N` for the N-th newest record (`^0` = newest). Default: the newest record.

### Read-Only

- `attachment_body` (String, Sensitive) Body of the attachment `attachment` selects (an in-toto statement for provenance and SBOMs), read from the builder's content store. Null without `attachment`. Sensitive: provenance can carry build arguments and source URLs.
- `buildx_version` (String) The buildx release whose output format and semantics this type mirrors (pin v0.38.2); not a runtime binary, the provider never runs buildx.
- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of inspect_json, to detect drift without diffing the document.
- `dockerfile_syntax` (String) Dockerfile frontend used, from the pkg:docker/docker/dockerfile material; empty when the default frontend ran.
- `inspect_json` (String, Sensitive) One build record as JSON (the `history inspect --format json` view). Sensitive: VCS URLs and build inputs can carry credentials.
- `name` (String) Build name, as `docker buildx history ls` shows it.
- `platforms` (List of String) Platforms the build produced (empty for the builder's default).
- `record` (Attributes) The build record field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--record))
- `vcs_revision` (String) Source revision the build was made from, when BuildKit recorded one.
